evidence: Matches the P2P label, modifies `src/net_processing.cpp`, and directly changes peer message handling and orphan transaction reconsideration logic.
rationale: Mitigates a peer message-processing stall where unresolvable orphans cause a node to validate all missing-input orphans in a single turn while holding `cs_main`. As noted in the commit history for CVE-2024-52914, interrupting reconsideration after each validation bounds per-turn latency and stops a peer from monopolizing message processing for all other peers.
